title: finding(tooling): `framework` has drifted 29,721 B BELOW its own `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` and sits at 0.63x — two thirds of the way to the blind-gauge leg, in the direction nobody watches
body:
Filed **bare** — no assignee, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*`, no priority. Placement, grading and whether this waits behind the open ruling on objectui#7848 are triage's call.

Measured en route to the objectui#7848 census round. ⛔ Nothing was implemented, ⛔ no constant was moved, and this card ⛔ does not ask for one to be moved — it asks for the drift to be looked at before the gauge stops measuring.

## The reading

Tip **`1f4e02995a`**. Method: fresh worktree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` (exit 0), `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` (exit 0), then `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` read **directly** — ⛔ not CI's report, ⛔ not extrapolated. Exit codes captured by redirect-then-capture, never through a pipe.

`REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` is 89 x 1024 = **91,136**.

| chunk | LIVE | `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` | live − baseline | ceiling | headroom | x regression |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `vendor-objectstack` | 1,240,263 | 1,235,029 | **+5,234** | 1,254,000 | 13,737 | 0.15x |
| `i18n-locale-en` | 40,415 | 40,415 | **0** | 50,000 | 9,585 | 0.11x |
| `ui-components` | 395,032 | 391,095 | **+3,937** | 399,000 | 3,968 | 0.04x |
| **`framework`** | **42,524** | **72,245** | **−29,721** | 100,000 | **57,476** | **0.63x** |

⭐ **The control is in the table.** Three of the four budgeted chunks sit at or ABOVE their pinned baselines in the very same report — one by +5,234, one by +3,937, and one exactly at it to the byte. So "below its baseline" is not a stuck answer from this instrument; it is a reading about this one row, and the only row it applies to.

## Why this is worth a card

`framework` measures **29,721 gzipped bytes below the figure the file says it was measured at**. The chunk did not grow past its ceiling — it shrank away from it, and nothing says so out loud.

Its ceiling was raised to 100,000 by the maintainer ruling of 2026-09-08, ⛔ not by a measurement, to cover bytes that had put `main` red on that line. The header records the cause as measured to `f76f43628` (+262) and `e76634cc8` (+984). Those bytes are no longer in the chunk. The ceiling raised to cover them still is.

⚠️ **The direction is the point.** Every reading on this board for the last two weeks has watched ceilings get TIGHTER — objectui#8554's floor, the `ui-components` exhausted-headroom allowance, the escalations on objectui#7848. This row moved the other way, which is exactly why nobody found it by looking where they were already looking. It is objectui#8554's defect class seen from the other side: a ceiling that has stopped being a measurement of this bundle.

And the file already rules on that direction in its own words, about this same chunk, in the paragraph recording the 2026-09-03 re-attribution:

> Left at 524,000 over a 61,465 payload, `framework` sits 5.08x above its own measurement and `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity` returns exit 2 — the blind-gauge verdict, correctly. ... ⚠️ Both new pairs are why the re-baseline is not optional.

At **0.63x** the row is not blind yet; the leg fires at 1.00x. It is two thirds of the way there, and it got there without a single commit being about it.

## What this card is NOT asking for

- ⛔ Not a ceiling raise. The opposite drift.
- ⛔ Not a lowering done on the strength of this reading alone. `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` and `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` move together, in one commit, on a declared measurement — the procedure the header already sets out — and the last move on this line was a maintainer ruling, so the next one is theirs to authorise too.
- ⛔ Not folded into objectui#7848 or objectui#9204. Different chunk, opposite direction, and #7848's own ruling is open.

The ask is one reading and a decision: **where did the 29,721 bytes go, and should the pair come down together before the row reaches 1.00x and the gauge reds as blind?**

## Reproduction

```
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build
node -e "const r=require('./apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json');for(const n of ['framework','vendor-objectstack','i18n-locale-en','ui-components'])console.log(n, r.files.find(f=>f.name===n).gzipBytes)"
```
